# EdgeWeb — Full Company & Service Reference

## Company Overview

EdgeWeb (legal name: EdgeWeb Infotech LLP) is a full-stack technology solutions company founded in 2019 and based in India, operating remote-first for clients in the United States, Europe, Australia and India. EdgeWeb's positioning statement is: "Technology should remove complexity — not relocate it." The company positions itself as a single full-stack partner rather than a fragmented vendor stack, serving both early-stage teams that need one product built well and established businesses that need system integration or replacement.

Contact: info@edgeweb.co | +91 92667 26490 (also WhatsApp) | linkedin.com/company/edgeweb

## How EdgeWeb Works (process)

EdgeWeb describes a six-stage engagement process:

1. Identify the actual business challenge (not a feature list)
2. Architecture planning before any code is written
3. Technology selection appropriate to the problem
4. Implementation, including automation where useful
5. AI integration where it adds real value
6. Measuring business outcomes, not just delivery

Typical engagement length is 6–16 weeks depending on scope, delivered in phases so clients see a working system early rather than a single release at the end. Most clients maintain a support or iteration arrangement after launch.

Enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, internal business platforms, CRM/ERP solutions, portals, dashboards, APIs, and legacy system modernization for businesses outgrowing off-the-shelf tools.
https://www.edgeweb.co/services/custom-software

AI agents and chatbots, workflow and business process automation, CRM/lead/WhatsApp automation, and data pipelines with API integrations — aimed at removing manual, repetitive work from a business.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What does EdgeWeb actually build?
A: Custom web and mobile applications, process automation, applied AI, cloud infrastructure and the data layer connecting them — plus the digital marketing to bring the right traffic once it's live.

Q: How does a project usually start?
A: Projects begin with discussions about actual business problems rather than feature lists, followed by architecture planning before coding begins.

Q: Do you work with early-stage businesses, or only established ones?
A: EdgeWeb serves both early-stage teams needing a single product built well and established businesses requiring system integration or replacement.

Q: What's the typical engagement length?
A: Most builds run 6–16 weeks depending on scope, scoped in phases so a working system ships early.

Q: Do you offer support after launch?
A: Yes — most clients maintain a support or iteration arrangement post-launch.

Q: Where is EdgeWeb based, and do you work with clients outside India?
A: EdgeWeb operates from India but serves both local and international clients through remote-first delivery.
